purpose: Make Controlled Randomize consumer-reachable from the exact current Song suggestion while preserving the artist's chosen distance and locks, respecting durable Not Now suppression, and refusing rather than faking a different local direction when none exists.

lineage.outcome: From the normal Song suggestion result, the artist can ask for another bounded local direction without silently changing the chosen creative distance, unlocking protected dimensions, resurfacing a suppressed idea, or granting action authority.

why_now: Canonical REQ-SCOPE-140 still retains explicit Controlled Randomize consumer reachability after deterministic local suggestions, More/Less soft feedback, and durable Not Now horizons were independently merged. CreativeSuggestionService already exposes bounded deterministic variation 0 through 1000, so the missing seam is consumer authority/state binding rather than another generator. Issue #189 owns this bounded gap. Earlier candidate heads 42a47a6eed276b1771d5f327e1b9e0abd306b3e1 and 2bfbbc14df5a35137d19620bc60af73dc56550bc never became merge authority because main advanced while they were being reconstructed. Main then carried independently verified source-of-belief, songwriting/vocal, semantic-definition lineage, and standards-aware A/B loudness-bias work. Exact A/B implementation head 4f146f2b5cf23c689ca56b63f0bb100a0dba5928 passed run 33946401600 on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows before PR #141 merged as ab1bb8f87a3d5b021d352a215302b14114312021; exact governance closure head 17b434a652d81d05879498c01680100ac3a5d9f0 then passed run 33946739080 on all three platforms before PR #192 merged as 538f5ea37d2c600f5139ea8a0e9401e535aa5cce. This receipt is therefore bound directly to that latest STABLE main while preserving the already-authored Controlled Randomize product/test blobs unchanged.

implementation_contract.reuse: Reuse CreativeSuggestionService.suggest(... variation=...), canonical active Song/latest Session identity, the existing ephemeral _creative_suggestion_result, SuggestionDeferralMemory, More/Less feedback compatibility, and existing Host/Origin/CSRF/one-shot action authority. Add no second generator, preference store, recommendation engine or persistence layer.
implementation_contract.server_held_constraints: The current distance, exact locked-dimension tuple and producing variation remain ephemeral server-side state. The randomize action token binds that exact state and current suggestion identity; client fields cannot change distance, unlock a dimension or select a variation.
implementation_contract.different_result: A successful randomize must return an eligible semantic suggestion key different from the currently shown key. If no such local result exists under the current distance, locks and suppression state, preserve the current prompt and report truthful unavailability.
implementation_contract.suppression: Every candidate is checked through current durable Not Now visibility before display. NEVER_SUGGEST_AGAIN, active NEXT_SONG and active LATER_THIS_SONG remain authoritative and are never bypassed by randomize.
implementation_contract.ephemeral: Randomize state survives normal page redirects only inside the current ConsumerShell process and disappears on relaunch; it creates no durable preference, taste, Learning or randomization history.
implementation_contract.authority: Controlled Randomize changes only which bounded local prompt is shown. It grants no Song/Version mutation, DAW/provider execution, publication, spend, purchase, activation, external write or other consequential authority.

completion_proof: the current Song suggestion renders one protected Try another direction action only when exact ephemeral distance/lock/variation state is available
foreign Origin is rejected before randomize action consumption and the same legitimate token remains usable afterward
client-supplied distance, variation or lock fields cannot change the server-held randomize constraints
successful randomize preserves exact distance and all locks while returning a different eligible semantic suggestion
a consumed randomize token cannot be replayed
a token bound to an earlier current suggestion fails closed after the current result changes
with only one eligible semantic suggestion under the current locks, randomize preserves the current prompt and truthfully reports that no different local option exists
existing NEVER_SUGGEST_AGAIN suppression remains effective during both initial suggestion selection and later randomize
a randomized suggestion remains valid input to the already-merged More/Less soft-feedback path without creating automatic weighting or action authority
randomize itself writes no feedback or deferral rows and its ephemeral result/state disappear on relaunch
exact-head construction governance, context lifecycle, supervision/runtime handoff, full regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS
